title: Almost perfection!
text: Almost perfection!. I REALLY like these storage bins because of the structure they provide.  They look much neater than others because of the wire supports, and the fabric is much thicker than other storage bins I purchased.  I would definitely feel comfortable packing clothes and linens in these for storage.  The only negative I have is that there was a slight plastic smell when they were first opened up but not nearly as strong as another brand of storage I bought.  I aired them out for a few days, and only time will tell if the smell lingers and transfers itself into my linens.

product_metadata.title: Storage Bins with Metal Frame - Stackable & Foldable Clothes Organizer Bags - Oxford Fabric Storage Containers with Large Clear Window & Carry Handles, Organization for Bedding, Linen, Clothes & More
